metadata.title: The Secret Wife's Return
metadata.subtitle: After three years as his hidden wife, I left signed divorce papers on his desk—and bought his rival conglomerate.

nodes.text: 11:58 PM · For three years Alexander hid your marriage from the press to "protect his image." Tonight, you left the ring and signed divorce papers on his desk.
{{player_name}}, what kind of tantrum is this? I missed ONE anniversary dinner because of a gala with Vivian. Come home right now.
Not a tantrum, Alexander. I'm freeing you to announce Vivian publicly. My lawyer will file at 9 AM.
Fine. Walk away if you think you can survive a week without my last name or my black card. Don't come crawling back.
10 Hours Later · 10:00 AM. Breaking Financial News: "Apex Holdings Acquires 51% Controlling Stake In Alexander's Rival—Led By Mystery Chairwoman {{player_name}}."
WAIT A SECOND—{{player_name}}?! YOU ARE THE HEIRESS OF APEX HOLDINGS?! WHY DIDN'T YOU EVER TELL ME?!
Oh god... my entire supply chain depends on Apex Holdings...

nodes.transcript: [panicked, breathless] {{player_name}}, I didn't sign the divorce papers! Tear them up—I'm calling a press conference to introduce you as my wife today!

nodes.prompt: The arrogant CEO who hid you for three years is begging on your phone.

options.label: Remind him you don't need his black card
options.player_reply_text: Surviving just fine without your black card, Alexander. See you at the merger summit.

options.label: Tell him you're launching a buyout of HIS firm
options.player_reply_text: Too late for press conferences. Check your Bloomberg terminal—Apex just bid for YOUR company.

nodes.text: Please, {{player_name}}! Don't destroy us—I never loved Vivian! I'm driving to Apex Tower right now!
My stock just spiked 40% on your takeover bid! {{player_name}}, wait for me in the boardroom!

nodes.headline: The Hidden Wife Takes The Throne.
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Alexander bursts into the Apex Tower lobby—and has to beg security just to see his own wife.

nodes.text: 11:15 AM · Floor 60, Apex Tower. You're watching Alexander stand in the rain outside the VIP lobby on your security monitor.
Your guards won't let me up without an appointment. {{player_name}}, I deserve every second of this humiliation. Just give me two minutes.
For three years I waited at home for you to spare me two minutes, Alexander. How does it feel from the lobby?
It feels like hell. I didn't realize how empty that house was until you took your things.

nodes.transcript: [voice breaking] Take my company, {{player_name}}. Keep the shares, fire me from the board—I don't care. Just don't erase three years of us.

nodes.prompt: Your assistant asks: "Chairwoman {{player_name}}, shall I send him up—or send him the final divorce decree?"

options.label: Send down the divorce papers—never look back
options.player_reply_text: Sign the divorce decree downstairs, Alexander. Apex will buy your firm fair and square.

options.label: Sign the divorce—and make him court you anew
options.player_reply_text: The marriage is over, Alexander. If you want a date with Chairwoman {{player_name}}, get in line.

nodes.text: I'll sign... because I owe you your freedom. Goodbye, {{player_name}}.
I'll be first in line every single morning, Chairwoman {{player_name}}. Even if it takes ten years.

nodes.headline: Long Live The Chairwoman.
nodes.teaser_text: Season Finale · You turn from the floor-to-ceiling window to lead the Apex board—your crown firmly on your own head.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · Apex Chairwoman’s Suite. Your merger announcement just tanked Alexander’s stock by 18% before the opening bell.
I haven’t touched this ring since you left it on my desk, {{player_name}}. Tell me the takeover isn’t just to punish me.
Don’t flatter yourself, Alexander. For three years you hid me from the world—now I’m simply buying the boardroom.

nodes.caption: Photo from his empty study · Your wedding band resting beside the signed divorce decree.

nodes.text: Your assistant pings: "Alexander’s board just called an emergency vote—and his mother is trying to oust him as CEO."
Let them vote me out. I hid our marriage because my uncle threatened to target my wife during the succession war—I was a coward for not telling you.
Even if you crush my company today, I’d still choose you over the Sterling crown.

nodes.transcript: [hoarse, exhausted] "I’m outside Apex Tower in the rain, {{player_name}}. I’m not asking you to stop the takeover. Just give me five minutes to explain the three years I stole from you."

nodes.prompt: Your ex-husband is standing downstairs while his board prepares to betray him.

options.label: Tell him he gets 5 minutes in your office
options.player_reply_text: Come up to Floor 50. Five minutes—and not a second more.

options.label: Buy his uncle’s shares to trap the board
options.player_reply_text: Come upstairs, Alexander. And watch what I’m about to do to your uncle’s shares.

nodes.text: In the elevator now. Thank you for not shutting me out completely.
Wait... you’re buying my uncle’s bloc?! {{player_name}}, why would you save me after how I treated you?!
My uncle just walked into Apex Lobby with a forged proxy contract. Don’t sign anything until I get there!

nodes.headline: The Proxy Trap.
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Alexander’s uncle tries to play you against your ex-husband—unaware the Chairwoman holds all the cards.

nodes.text: 11:15 AM · Floor 50 Conference Room. Alexander stands soaked beside your leather chair as his uncle slides a merger pact across.
Look at Clause 9, {{player_name}}. My uncle buried a poison pill—if you sign, he takes both Apex AND my company.
I spotted Clause 9 twenty minutes ago, Alexander. Did you think I became Chairwoman by luck?
No... I always knew you were brilliant. That’s why hiding you in that villa was the biggest sin of my life.
His uncle sneers: "She’s just your discarded housewife, Alexander—sign the surrender!"
Say the word, {{player_name}}. I’ll publicly declare you as my wife and transfer my voting bloc to you right here.
I don’t care if the whole financial press laughs at me kneeling to my ex-wife.

nodes.transcript: [clear, commanding] "Listen closely, Uncle. You’re speaking to the woman who just bought your debt—and the only woman I will ever love."

nodes.prompt: Every camera in the glass boardroom is watching you.

options.label: Tear up his uncle’s contract live
options.player_reply_text: Keep your poison pill. Apex is acquiring your shares at my price.

options.label: Accept Alexander’s voting bloc & win
options.player_reply_text: Transfer your votes, Alexander. Let’s show your uncle who owns this city.

nodes.text: His face went ghost-white! You just ended his career in ten seconds flat.
Signed and notarized. Every share I own now answers to you, Chairwoman.
Wait—my uncle dropped his briefcase on the way out. Look at the contract hidden inside.

nodes.headline: The Three-Year Truth.
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: A hidden 2023 agreement reveals Alexander secretly funded your first startup—even while you thought he didn’t care.

nodes.text: 4:20 PM · Empty Apex office. Rain taps the 50th-floor glass as you stare at the 2023 seed-investment deed.
I never meant for you to find that, {{player_name}}. You built Apex with your own genius—I only made sure my uncle couldn’t block your bank loans.
You protected me in secret for three years... why didn’t you just trust me with the truth?!

nodes.caption: Angel Investment Deed · 2023 — Anonymous seed capital for your startup, signed by A. Sterling.

nodes.text: The divorce court clerk sends an automated reminder: the 30-day cooling-off period expires at midnight tonight.
Because I was arrogant enough to think keeping you in the dark meant keeping you safe. I was wrong—and I paid for it.
At midnight our marriage officially ends... unless you want to make me earn a second wedding.

nodes.transcript: [low, vulnerable] "I put the ring back in my pocket, {{player_name}}. If you let midnight pass, I’ll respect it. But I’ll still be waiting outside your door tomorrow."

nodes.prompt: Seven hours until the divorce becomes final. What does the Chairwoman decide?

options.label: Finalize divorce—make him court you anew
options.player_reply_text: Let the secret marriage end tonight, Alexander. If you want me, court me in the light.

options.label: Meet him on the balcony before midnight
options.player_reply_text: Don’t leave the building, Alexander. Meet me on the rooftop at 11:50 PM.

nodes.text: In the light, in front of the whole world. Starting tomorrow morning at 8 AM sharp.
I’ll be there at 11:00—just in case you come early.
No more secret wives. From tonight on, the whole world knows your name.

nodes.headline: Midnight On Floor 50.
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Finale): Under the city skyline, the Chairwoman and the fallen CEO write a brand-new vow—as equals.

nodes.text: 11:52 PM · Apex Helipad. City skyscrapers glow like stars as Alexander drops to one knee in front of you.
Three years ago I married you in a quiet courthouse and hid you from the cameras. That man deserved to lose you.
And who is the man kneeling on my helipad right now?
The man who just booked a full-page announcement in every paper in the city—declaring I’m chasing the Chairwoman of Apex.
Across the skyline, the Sterling Tower billboard lights up: "MARRY ME IN THE LIGHT, {{player_name}}."
No more shadows. No more secrets. Just two crowns, side by side.
I love you more than my name, my empire, and my own breath.

nodes.transcript: [deep, trembling] "Will you let me start over as your husband in the sunlight, {{player_name}}—this time with the whole world watching?"

nodes.prompt: The skyline blazes with your name. Give him your royal decree.

options.label: Pull him up and say yes to a new vow
options.player_reply_text: Get up, Alexander. You have yourself a deal—on my terms.

options.label: Kiss him beneath the glowing billboard
options.player_reply_text: Yes, Alexander. Welcome back to my side—as my equal.

nodes.text: Always on your terms, Chairwoman. I’ll spend forever proving you chose right.
I love you, {{player_name}}. Forever in the light.
Long live the Chairwoman—and the man who finally learned her worth. 👑

nodes.headline: Season Finale · Crowned In Love.
nodes.teaser_text: THE END · You didn’t just reclaim your crown—you rebuilt love on your own unbreakable terms.
